units.source_text: 在我迟疑的当口，妻子惊叫一声，往竹林深处逃跑了。

en.t: While I hesitated, my wife screamed and fled deep into the bamboo grove.

units.source_text: 匪徒立马追了过去，但是扑了个空。

en.t: The bandit immediately chased after her, but he failed to catch her.

units.source_text: 我简直是在梦里看到这幅景象的。

en.t: It was as though I were watching the scene in a dream.
